notes: TWO DEFECTS WITH ONE ROOT, BOTH FOUND WHILE TRYING TO SHIP A TWENTY-LINE UX CHANGE THE OWNER ASKED FOR, AND BOTH OF WHICH HAD TO BE FIXED FIRST. (1) THE SEED COULD NOT UPDATE A METHOD IT HAD ALREADY SEEDED — AND THE FILE SAID SO IN ITS OWN HEADER. server/st-browser-seed.js declared the rule correctly: *"A 5.185.0 installation that later takes a release with a corrected method MUST RECEIVE IT — but an OWNER EDIT MUST NOT BE OVERWRITTEN."* It then implemented compile a method only when the class does not carry it at all, which satisfies the second half and defeats the first.
